name: Channel 8
source:
Matters take a turn for the worse when, fleeing from danger, Kiel falls into the age-old horror trope of heading upstairs. Trapped and pressed for options, the chinchilla does what he can to manage the mess while holed up in a stranger’s home.

[From [url=https://this-fucking-dork.itch.io/channel-8]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
基尔为了逃离危险，偏偏落入恐怖片的老套路——往楼上跑。事情就此急转直下。这只毛丝鼠被困在陌生人家里，能选的路没剩几条，只得躲在里面，尽自己所能应付眼下的烂摊子。
